This is a WHY error. The stated goal is 'community safety', but the actual effect is the suppression of political dissent.

By labeling criticism as 'poisonous', the council uses a pretext of safety to maintain power over discourse. It is a classic projection of fear to justify censorship.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Censorship creates systemic instability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Speech can be deeply offensive.

The Unavoidable Lie: Denying visas is a neutral safety measure.
